expr: return { title: document.title, ready: document.readyState, dropzone: !!document.querySelector('.dropzone'), nav: [...document.querySelectorAll('.nav__item')].map(n=>n.textContent.trim()) };

const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-file-card]')]; return cards.map(c => ({ name: c.querySelector('.filecard__name').textContent, state: c.dataset.state, results: [...c.querySelectorAll('.result__name')].map(n=>n.textContent), notes: [...c.querySelectorAll('.case__detail')].map(e=>e.textContent.slice(0,120)).slice(0,4), errors: [...c.querySelectorAll('[data-status=fail] .case__detail')].map(e=>e.textContent.slice(0,160)) }));
